title: console: a screen flow renders every screen in a fixed 448px single-column dialog, so a long screen pushes its Submit below the viewport on a 1440px display (17.7.0)
body:
Filing class: ① product defect (user-visible) — reach: browser, measured once on 17.7.0. Maintainer instruction for platform problems found in the hotclm browser test, verbatim, 2026-10-10: 「你遇到的平台问题应该提交issue」.

**Reader:** objectui triage → the console's screen-flow runner (the dialog that hosts a flow screen).

## Symptom

Measured in `objectstack-ai/hotclm` during its full browser pass on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0 (objectstack-ai/hotclm#87, `main` @ `c31c7e2`), Chromium 1194, viewport 1440×900, signed in as a business requester launching the app's intake screen flow (`contract_intake`).

- The screen dialog measures **448px wide** (on screen x=496–944) — exactly Tailwind's `max-w-md` — and stays 448px however wide the window is. Every field renders in one column.
- The intake flow's second screen carries 13 fields (title, signing entity, department, amount, currency, estimate flag, start/end date, term, summary, governing law, confidentiality term, …). In a 448px single column it is taller than the viewport: the **Submit / Next button sits below the fold**, and the user has to discover that the overlay scrolls. Screenshot: `qa/browser-test-17-7/screenshots/18-finding-intake-step2-submit-below-viewport-after-wheel.png` on branch `claude/issue-87-browser-test-17-7` of `objectstack-ai/hotclm` (taken after a mouse-wheel scroll; the page behind is dimmed, two thirds of the screen unused).

## Expected

A screen dialog sized to its content — wider on wide displays, or a multi-column layout for long screens, as record forms already get — with the primary action always reachable (sticky footer). The app cannot change this: the screen spec carries no width or layout hint for the dialog, and splitting the screen in two just to fit a fixed width would be an app-side workaround of a platform limit.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on `objectstack-ai/objectui`, query `flow screen dialog fixed narrow width max-w-md submit button below viewport long screen` → 5 hits, none on the flow runner: #620 / #705 / #679 / #618 (closed, Feb 2026 — `ModalForm` record-form dialogs), #11795 (closed — Studio below tablet width).

---
_Filed by the `repo:hotclm` PM seat from a measured browser finding._
